about: The Great Hall of 1897 as a table to join (Godric's yes on req 2585, 1 November 2026, under req 2312): he sits at the Gryffindor table and the first-year beside him hands him the toast; he may ask the house ghost, and the candles over that table dip to the question; a dish he takes at dinner comes back changed after the night. Tap ids (gryffindor table, house ghost, pie dish, pudding dish) wait on the Hall's page. The 1990s doings (hall panel, post owl, howler) stay in great-hall.json.
